historic_crs_statement: ASSUMED_EPSG4326; source provides X/Y values but does not establish datum in this table.

modern.crs: EPSG:4326 (GeoJSON coordinates interpreted as longitude/latitude; source has no explicit CRS member).
modern.name_policy: Chinese names are read from ModernChinaCountyTable.csv by administrative code; GeoJSON NAME_CH is ignored because it is mojibake.

name_disambiguation.rule: unique modal exact Chinese name among non-History Data rows; tied mode excluded

modern.alias_policy: All nonempty PROV_CH/PCODE, CITY_CH/DCODE, and COUNTY_CH/CODE2020 source names are attached by code regardless of NOTE, together with nonempty output of the supplied official modern normalizer. Generic administrative labels (市区/市辖区/辖区) are excluded from aliases. No inferred names are added; conflicting source names remain multiple aliases.
modern.history_data_alias_policy: History Data rows are included only as source-evidenced aliases by the codes present in those rows; NOTE does not create a name or change geometry.

historic.level_method: Use the supplied row-level County/Prefecture/Province annotation; numeric LEVEL is hierarchy depth, not administrative level. Unknown/Town/Dynasty/ambiguous labels are excluded.

neighbors.geometry_policy: All finite in-range source OBJ_TYPE=POINT rows; level, name-class, and annotation filters do not apply.

raw_year_zero_values.policy: 0 is retained as a source year; no sentinel meaning is assumed.

historic.crs: ASSUMED_EPSG4326; source provides X/Y values but does not establish datum in this table.
historic.geometry_policy: Only source OBJ_TYPE=POINT records become point geometries; source polygons are not reconstructed from a point coordinate.

source_population.geometry_policy: All finite in-range source OBJ_TYPE=POINT rows; level, name-class, and annotation filters do not apply.

gazetteer_metadata.predictions_and_labels: Gazetteer inputs contain no labels or LLM predictions; human labels and predictions stay in separate output layers.

method: RuntimeGeocoder.geocode_rows on exact-name references derived from corpus occurrences; no model/API call; names with non-unique results remain unresolved.
